<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
// Assessment-only driver; run from the repository root. No package inputs are written.
require getcwd() . '/vendor/autoload.php';
use PhpGrammar\Php\Conformance\{GrammarRepository,GrammarCoverageAnalyzer,PhpGrammarMatcher,Php85CoverageClassification};
use PhpGrammar\Repository\RepositoryManifest;
use PhpGrammar\Ebnf\Coverage\CoverageCollector;
function jsonRead(string $p): array { return json_decode(file_get_contents($p), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); }
function writeJson(string $p, array $v): void { file_put_contents($p,json_encode($v,JSON_PRETTY_PRINT|JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES|JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)."\n"); }
function snapshot(): array {
 $a=[];
 foreach (['grammar','src','tests','tools','bin','schema','docs'] as $dir) {
  foreach(new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($dir,FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)) as $f) if($f->isFile()) {
   $p=str_replace('\\','/',$f->getPathname()); if(str_starts_with($p,'docs/8.6/completeness-')) continue;
   $a[$p]=hash_file('sha256',$p);
  }
 }
 foreach(glob('*') as $p) if(is_file($p)) $a[$p]=hash_file('sha256',$p);
 foreach(['.gitattributes','.gitignore'] as $p) if(is_file($p)) $a[$p]=hash_file('sha256',$p);
 ksort($a);return $a;
}
$mode=$argv[1]??'coverage';
if($mode==='snapshot'){writeJson('.audit/phase5a-baseline.json',snapshot());echo count(snapshot())." files recorded\n";exit;}
if($mode==='preserve'){
 $before=jsonRead('.audit/phase5a-baseline.json');$after=snapshot();$diff=[];
 foreach($before as $p=>$h)if(($after[$p]??null)!==$h)$diff[]=$p;
 $protected=array_filter($before,fn($p)=>preg_match('~^(grammar/8\.[56]/|tests/fixtures/php/8\.5/|docs/8\.5/|tools/8\.5/)~',$p),ARRAY_FILTER_USE_KEY);
 writeJson('docs/8.6/completeness-preservation.json',['baselineCommit'=>'11496fba8ae706b05bc500d99b8c0326a41054fc','baselineFiles'=>$before,'checked'=>count($before),'protectedCount'=>count($protected),'changed'=>$diff,'addedOutsideAssessment'=>array_values(array_diff(array_keys($after),array_keys($before)))]);
 echo json_encode(['checked'=>count($before),'protected'=>count($protected),'changed'=>$diff])."\n";exit($diff?1:0);
}
$m=RepositoryManifest::fromRepositoryRoot(getcwd());$repo=new GrammarRepository($m);$g=$repo->load('8.6');$old=$repo->load('8.5');
$witnesses=$primitiveWitnesses=[];
$r=(new GrammarCoverageAnalyzer($m))->analyze('8.6',[],function($w,$c)use(&$witnesses,&$primitiveWitnesses){foreach([...$c->matchedProductions(),...$c->matchedAlternatives()] as $id)$witnesses[$id][]=$w;foreach($c->matchedPrimitives() as $id)$primitiveWitnesses[$id][]=$w;});
$primitiveNames=PhpGrammarMatcher::forManifest($m)->lexicalPrimitiveNames();
$classifier=new Php85CoverageClassification($g,$primitiveNames);
$reachable=[];$walk=function($name)use(&$walk,&$reachable,$g){if(isset($reachable[$name])||!$g->hasProduction($name))return;$reachable[$name]=true;foreach($g->production($name)->references()as$n)$walk($n);};
$walk('source-file');$sourceReach=$reachable;$walk('whitespace');$walk('comment');
$negative=[];$fixtures=[];
foreach(['valid','invalid','contextual-invalid','runtime'] as $kind)foreach(glob("tests/fixtures/php/8.6/$kind/*.php")as$p){
 $p=str_replace('\\','/',$p);$c=new CoverageCollector();$result=PhpGrammarMatcher::forManifest($m)->withCoverage($c)->matches('8.6',file_get_contents($p));
 $fixtures[$p]=['kind'=>$kind,'sha256'=>hash_file('sha256',$p),'structuralMatch'=>$result->matched];
 if($kind==='invalid'||$kind==='contextual-invalid')foreach([...$c->enteredProductions(),...$c->visitedAlternatives()]as$id)$negative[$id][]=$p;
}
$change=jsonRead('tools/8.6/change-map.json');$rows=[];$counts=[];
foreach(['production'=>$r->identityMap->productions(),'alternative'=>$r->identityMap->alternatives()]as$kind=>$ids)foreach($ids as$id){
 $p=explode('/',$id)[0];$c=$classifier->classify($id);$positive=$witnesses[$id]??[];
 // Reuse only graph-based exclusions; the PHP 8.5 enum contextual exception is not independently certified for 8.6.
 $excluded=in_array($c['classification'],['primitive-bypassed','trivia-removed'],true);
 $status=$positive?'indirectly-exercised':($excluded?'excluded-with-justification':($c['classification']==='scanner-context-only'?'unresolved':'uncovered'));
 if($kind==='production'&&$positive){$alternatives=array_filter($r->identityMap->alternatives(),fn($a)=>str_starts_with($a,$p.'/'));foreach($alternatives as$a)if(!isset($witnesses[$a])){$status='partially-exercised';break;}}
 $findingIds=[];foreach($change['findings'] as $fid=>$f)if(in_array($p,$f['productions']??[],true))$findingIds[]=$fid;
 $rows[$kind][$id]=['classification'=>$status,'rawPositiveExercised'=>(bool)$positive,'reason'=>$positive?'Completed chart item in accepted whole-source fixture; no unique derivation claim.':($excluded?$c['reason']:'No positive chart witness; investigate or add a source-backed witness.'),'sourceReachable'=>isset($sourceReach[$p]),'configuredRootsReachable'=>isset($reachable[$p]),'structurallyParsed'=>true,'changedFrom85'=>isset($change['productions'][$p]),'findings'=>$findingIds,'sourceCorrespondence'=>$findingIds?'Focused finding map in tools/8.6/change-map.json; not exhaustive production reconciliation.':'Inherited structure; no independent per-production RC4 reconciliation asserted.','positiveWitnesses'=>$positive,'negativeAttempts'=>$negative[$id]??[],'negativeBoundaryStatus'=>'Unresolved at identity level: attempted chart visits do not isolate the rejected boundary.','contextualLimitation'=>'Structural matching does not enforce compiler predicates; see assessment contextual inventory.'];
 $counts[$kind][$status]=($counts[$kind][$status]??0)+1;
}
$pfa=[];foreach(array_keys($change['productions'])as$p){$ids=array_values(array_filter($r->identityMap->alternatives(),fn($id)=>str_starts_with($id,$p.'/')));$pfa[$p]=['alternatives'=>$ids,'exercised'=>array_values(array_filter($ids,fn($id)=>isset($witnesses[$id]))),'optionalTaken'=>array_values(array_filter($r->matched->optionalTaken(),fn($id)=>str_starts_with($id,$p.'/'))),'optionalSkipped'=>array_values(array_filter($r->matched->optionalSkipped(),fn($id)=>str_starts_with($id,$p.'/')))];}
$hashes=[];foreach(['grammar/8.5/php.ebnf','grammar/8.5/php.md','grammar/8.6/php.ebnf','grammar/8.6/php.md','grammar/8.6/changes.md','php-grammar.json','src/Php/Conformance/GrammarCoverageAnalyzer.php','src/Ebnf/Coverage/CoverageIdentityMap.php','src/Php/Conformance/Php85CoverageClassification.php','.audit/php85/php.exe','.audit/php86/php.exe']as$p)$hashes[$p]=hash_file('sha256',$p);
$data=['schema'=>'phase5a-assessment-1','baselineCommit'=>'11496fba8ae706b05bc500d99b8c0326a41054fc','hashes'=>$hashes,'method'=>'Existing GrammarCoverageAnalyzer, no extra rule cases; positive completed chart items, not unique derivations. Invalid attempts separate; graph exclusions are not RC4 scanner certification.','current'=>['productions'=>$r->exercisedProductions(),'totalProductions'=>$r->totalProductions(),'productionPercent'=>$r->productionCoveragePercentage(),'alternatives'=>$r->exercisedAlternatives(),'totalAlternatives'=>$r->totalAlternatives(),'alternativePercent'=>$r->alternativeCoveragePercentage(),'attemptedProductions'=>$r->attemptedProductions(),'attemptedAlternatives'=>$r->attemptedAlternatives(),'sourceReachable'=>count($sourceReach),'configuredRootsReachable'=>count($reachable)],'classificationCounts'=>$counts,'identities'=>$rows,'primitiveWitnesses'=>$primitiveWitnesses,'pfa'=>$pfa,'fixtures'=>$fixtures,'reproduction'=>['command'=>'rtk proxy .audit/php85/php.exe -n .audit/phase5a.php coverage','driverSource'=>file_get_contents(__FILE__)]];
writeJson('docs/8.6/completeness-coverage.json',$data);echo json_encode(['current'=>$data['current'],'classificationCounts'=>$counts,'pfa'=>$pfa],JSON_PRETTY_PRINT)."\n";
